kjv: and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd
mine: So there will be one flock, one shepherd
note: poimne is "flock", not "aule" ("fold", used earlier in the verse). The KJV (following the Vulgate's "ovile") makes Jesus promise one institutional enclosure rather than one flock under one shepherd.

kjv: My Father, which gave [them] me, is greater than all
mine: What My Father has given Me is greater than all
note: SBLGNT follows B, Sinaiticus with neuter "ho … meizon"; TR has masculine "hos … meizon". The manuscripts are divided.
